dialogues.speaker: Ancient Scroll
dialogues.text: "...The beasts... of whom the azure Suanni known as the Mountain Lord was chief... pursued into the mountains, but not one was harmed by the creatures..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Scroll
dialogues.text: "...Arrived at the adeptus's abode, a great flood came... The women and children all were saved, but of the Suanni's whereabouts none knew."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Scroll
dialogues.text: "...Perhaps that Suanni might have been that adeptus... but I fear that great adeptus's light, lovely as Yaoguang, could not be matched by any Suanni... Though such beneficence still is worthy of remembrance..."
